move.title: Move group
move.lead: Run these commands in the local command line, not in this browser. A group can move only to another computer of its owner.
move.export: On {computer}, export to one of your other computers:
move.none: No other computer of yours is known. Replace DEVICE_ID with the destination computer's device id.
move.import: Copy group.sqlite to the chosen computer by any means, then run there:
move.warning: Export with --to stops this computer from being the home immediately. The group is unavailable until import finishes. Do not resend an unanswered command: receipts stay on the old computer, so it could run twice.
move.copy: For a safekeeping copy, omit --to and the device id; the current computer stays the home. If import fails, you can import the file on the old computer again.
